summary: T1 item 2 (layout): layout/cells/rcosc_top.gds is the committed GDS of the composed block; it instantiates rcosc_bias, rcosc_trim_bank, rcosc_comparator and rcosc_comparator_p as real GDS sub-cells and is regenerated by layout/run_checks.sh. Items 3 (DRC) and 11 (ERC half) pin the same bytes; layout/reports/rcosc_top.extract.json records its device/net inventory. 'pass' asserts the stream is the committed, current layout of the whole block; DRC/LVS cleanliness is items 3 and 4, not this one.
